text:
Karen (marketing-ops): Heads up — RevOps alerted that inbound leads from the pricing page are hitting a 24+ hour unassigned state and we're blowing SLAs. Can we triage quick fixes today?
Miguel (revops): Saw the alert. Looks like enrichment webhook is sometimes returning null for `company_size`, which stalls the HubSpot workflow wait step. revops-bot reported 42 leads unassigned > 12h overnight.
Tara (sales-lead): Ugh. That wait-until-property workflow was to avoid mis-assigning before enrichment, but it's creating an assignment blackhole. We need a fallback owner.
Sam (sdr): Suggested quick patch: change workflow to "Delay 10m then assign to SDR-pool" instead of wait-on-property. We can backfill later once enrichment finishes. :+1:
Karen (marketing-ops): Agree. Can someone make the workflow change and run a backfill CSV for the ones stuck? I can do CSV if I get the list.
Miguel (revops): I'll run a query to export leads where `hs_lead_status = 'new' AND owner IS NULL AND createdate >= -48h` and push to /tmp/lead-backfill.csv. Also going to add a fallback assignment action: if enrichment doesn't set company_size within 5m, set owner = `SDR-fallback`.
Tara (sales-lead): Please also add a short-term KPI to track — Time to assignment median and % assigned <15m. We need to measure improvement after the change.
revops-bot: SLA breach count: 42 leads >12h unassigned, median time-to-assign (24h window): 3h45m.
Sam (sdr): For the backfill, prefer to route by inferred intent: lead.source=pricing_page -> priority=HIGH, so SDRs call first. Can we flag those in the CSV?
Miguel (revops): Yes — extracting `lead.source`, `hs_analytics_first_url`, and last_activity. Will add `priority` column with mapping: pricing_page -> HIGH, docs -> MED, blog -> LOW.
Karen (marketing-ops): Workflow change plan (short): 1) Edit HubSpot workflow "Inbound - assign_v2": replace Wait(until property=company_size) with Delay 10m -> Set owner SDR-fallback. 2) Add webhook to retry enrichment asynchronously. 3) Run backfill CSV to assign owners and tag priority. 4) Monitor SLA dashboard for 2 business cycles.
Tara (sales-lead): Sounds good. Also please add a rule in Salesforce sync mapping: if HS owner = SDR-fallback then SF Owner = "Marketing Handoff Queue" to avoid creating duplicate ownership churn.
Miguel (revops): Copy. I'll push the workflow edit now and share changelog. Running backfill script in 10m.
Sam (sdr): Reminder: SDRs will claim HIGH priority pricing leads first. We'll update playbook slack snippet.
Karen (marketing-ops): I'll update the playbook and KPI doc. Posting link to the dashboard when available. Thanks team :rocket:
revops-bot: Workflow edit completed by Miguel at 1771110305. Backfill job started at 1771110400.
Miguel (revops): Backfill finished, 39/42 assigned (3 failed due to invalid emails). I'm uploading the CSV to the shared drive: https://redwood-internal/files/lead-backfill-1771110400.csv
Tara (sales-lead): Nice, can we get a quick retrospective tomorrow? Want to verify enrichment root cause and ensure long-term fix (make enrichment idempotent).
Karen (marketing-ops): Scheduled 11am tomorrow. I've added agenda: root cause, permanent workflow redesign, SLA thresholds, and alert tuning.
Sam (sdr): Good call. Also can we add a gating test in staging to simulate enrichment nulls before prod deploys?
Miguel (revops): Will add unit test and a canary run for the enrichment webhook. Closing this thread after postmortem.
